TECHNICAL REVIEW

Information required for quotation

Electrical ratingsRated power, HV / MV / LV voltage, frequency, phase, vector group
PerformanceImpedance, no-load loss, load loss, temperature rise, sound and efficiency target
Insulation and regulationInsulation levels, tap range, OLTC or off-circuit tapping
InstallationIndoor / outdoor, altitude, ambient temperature, coastal or corrosive environment
InterfacesBushings, cable entry, switchgear, protection, metering, monitoring and communications
DocumentsSingle-line diagram, tender specification, site layout, load profile and harmonic data
